snippet.title: Shambles Gameplay
snippet.description:
Here's Notch's newest, little game that he created for Game Jam. It's a zombie-based fps with graphics and gameplay straight out of the build engine. I find it strangely alluring despite that, however.

You are basically dropped into the middle of a city surrounded by civilians and soldiers. The game randomly spawns one zombie at a time at certain locations and the NPCs can be converted much like in Minecraft. So, before long, you can find yourself quickly surrounded by the undead.

Download Here: http://7dfps.com/?action=games&id=171
